name: clawd-notify
description: Tells you when Claude is done or needs you: a desktop notification, a chime, and optionally a push to your phone

minSeconds.title: Only turns longer than (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Notify that Claude is done only when the turn ran at least this long, so quick answers you watched don't ping you.

onPermission.title: When Claude needs approval
onPermission.description: Notify when Claude is waiting on a permission dialog.

onIdle.title: When Claude waits for input
onIdle.description: Notify when Claude has been waiting for your next prompt for a while.

desktop.title: Desktop notification
desktop.description: auto: your terminal's notifications, falling back to the system's (notify-send, osascript). terminal: the terminal's only. system: the system's only. off: none.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A short chime when Claude is done, a different one when it needs you.

phoneUrl.title: Phone push URL
phoneUrl.description: An ntfy topic URL (https://ntfy.sh/<a-long-random-topic>, or your own ntfy server) to push to your phone. Empty: no phone push.

phoneMinSeconds.title: Phone: only turns longer than (seconds)
phoneMinSeconds.description: Push 'done' to your phone only for turns at least this long. Approval requests always push.
